en.title: HUD Rescinds Fair Housing ‘Continuing Violation’ Rule, Impacting Disability Access
en.summary: HUD issued new guidance withdrawing the ‘continuing violation’ interpretation of the Fair Housing Act’s design-and-construction accessibility requirements, affecting compliance assessments for new housing. Meanwhile, Kentucky’s governor announced over $18.8 million for pedestrian and bicyclist projects that include accessibility upgrades such as curb cuts and sidewalks. Masats will showcase AI‑powered accessibility tools at FIAA 2026, while a new app earned accessibility certification and advocates called for mindful assistance and disability‑award nominations.

zh-TW.title: HUD 撤銷公平住房法『持續違反』解釋，影響無障礙住宅合規
zh-TW.summary: 美國住房與城市發展部（HUD）發布新指引，撤銷對公平住房法設計與建築無障礙要求的『持續違反』解釋，影響新住宅的合規評估。貝謝爾州長宣布超過1880萬美元用於行人、騎車者及無障礙基礎設施，包括路邊坡道和人行道改善。Masats 將在 FIAA 2026 展出 AI 驅動的無障礙解決方案，而華南 e指沖 App 獲得無障礙認證，歐盟更新數位無障礙標準，並有日本帳號分享殘障運動體驗課程。
